result.title: Random Voronoi Networks
result.summary: Nearest-neighbor methods are local, simple, and interpretable, but their non-parametric form makes them memory-intensive, expensive at inference, and difficult to integrate into differentiable neural architectures. We introduce Random Voronoi Networks (RVNs), a family of structured three-layer MLPs that express nearest-neighbor geometry through sampled Voronoi comparisons. The first layer computes Random Voronoi Features (RVF) from affine pairwise separators between selected training samples, the second layer aggregates these comparisons into Voronoi cells or top-k neighborhood scores, and the readout layer produces classification or regression predictions. We show that, when all samples and pairwise comparisons are included, step RVNs recover exact Euclidean k-NN, while ReLU RVNs provide a violation-score realization for 1-NN that can be relaxed into a differentiable soft weighting. Subsampling yields approximate RVNs with explicit control over the number of cells and features. We study several unsupervised sampling methods that trade off random coverage, directional diversity, coordinate sparsity, and empirical feature variance. Empirically, RVFs produce a highly effective data encoding strategy, providing performance boosts to downstream methods ranging from linear to modern tabular deep learning models. Finally, we showcase that RVF provides an interpretable feature map due to its k-NN based construction and ties to pairwise local directions. These results position our Random Voronoi formulation as a bridge between nearest-neighbor rules, random features, and modern tabular models.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Random Voronoi Networks：用采样样本间的仿射成对分离器构造第一层 Voronoi 特征，再由聚合层与读出层组成三层 MLP，在完整设置下可还原精确 k-NN、在 ReLU 形式下给出可微的 1-NN 违例分数，并提供可解释特征图与表格任务上的编码增益。
AI.relevance_reason: 其可微 k-NN/Voronoi 单元与成对局部方向特征，可能为 LVR 中按相似度筛选视觉证据、刻画 latent 邻域几何提供方法线索，但论文限于表格数据，与视觉推理无直接联系，需核查可迁移性。
